baseline.method: Original second-order TV/TGV source baseline, 20000 Condat-Vu steps
baseline.reference: standard-method estimate, not actual source truth

relative_complex_l2_definition: norm(complex estimate - complex reference)/norm(complex reference), all pixels; no phase/gain alignment
observation_relative_l2_definition: norm(independent complex128 SI free-field propagator times relative source - public pressure)/norm(public pressure)
provenance: Stage/full-run relative2e-5 float32 tolerance fixed before extraction. Original exact-bound data run; independent source reconstruction and full local comparison pass. Nonzero reference tolerance avoids self-comparison-zero thresholds. Observation boundary is1.05 times original residual. All outputs retain fixed author processed pressure amplitude/phase; no actual volume-velocity truth exists.
